scheme_name: Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must have knowledge of tailoring.

Applicant must belong to one of the following groups: Destitute Woman, Widow, Deserted Woman, Differently Abled Man, Differently Abled Woman, Socially Affected Woman, or Woman from Economically Weaker Sections.
benefits_summary: Free sewing machine and accessories are provided.
